comment.message: De-risk draft ready for review (2d2274d). All 3 POSIX targets cross-compile from Linux; darwin pinned to minos 11.0 via own zig linker wrapper (cargo-zigbuild default gives 15.0). Darwin binaries NOT yet executed on a Mac. Parity 60/60 with schema ref normalised. Java/beta write different schema.location values to the shared config (05 ��4 'agree' claim is false unless Java changes too).

Correction to the previous comment: no schema.location ping-pong. Both writers add [toml-schema] only if absent (Rust config_writer.rs:114, Java ConfigWriter.java:83), so the first product to create shipsmooth.toml sets location and the other never changes it. 05 ��4's 'overwrite each other' concern is likewise false.

Config-isolation de-risk draft ready for review (a2056ba): resolver with_fallback(beta, shared), ConfigWriter::seeded_from(shared). 294 Rust tests / 0 failed, clippy clean, parity 60/60. Manual check: shared file sha unchanged across beta init; beta finds Java-set-up repos before and after the seed. One-way gap only matters for separate-dir (same-repo is found from the filesystem without a config entry).

deviation.message: Scope addition (user-directed, 2026-10-13): beta config isolation. Reads use shipsmooth-beta.toml if present, else shipsmooth.toml; a project missing from shipsmooth-beta.toml falls back to shipsmooth.toml. First write seeds shipsmooth-beta.toml from shipsmooth.toml (atomic copy), and all writes go only to shipsmooth-beta.toml. The beta never writes shipsmooth.toml. Knock-ons: parity run.sh captures shipsmooth-beta.toml on the Rust side; IT-2 asserts shipsmooth.toml is byte-identical after beta runs (Task 4); Task 5 docs describe the copy and the one-way visibility.

update.message: Major deviation before preamble: install-shipsmooth.sh is NOT launcher-agnostic (05 premise wrong). :40 BIN=$RUNTIME_DIR/bin/shipsmooth and :65-66 EXTRACTED_BIN=bin/shipsmooth are hardcoded, so a zip containing bin/shipsmooth-beta dies 'extracted archive is missing bin/shipsmooth'. bin/$NAME is not a safe fix: opencode dev passes NAME=shipsmooth-dev with a Java bin/shipsmooth. Also: hook commands in harness/shared/build.gradle.kts:213,223,233,256 hardcode the 'shipsmooth' NAME argument (and :213 the plugins/cache/bitkentech/shipsmooth fallback path), which Task 2 must cover. Awaiting human decision: keep launcher bin/shipsmooth vs optional 3rd installer arg vs bin/$NAME.

Unblocked by plan-115-v2: the beta gets a separate install-shipsmooth-beta.sh (Java install-shipsmooth.sh untouched). Task 2 scope widened (beta installer, HookCommandRenderer script detection, lint task, Claude hook command :213), risk stays Medium. Task ids/risks unchanged from v1.
